summary: PORTREAD is a simple batch program that reads and displays every record in the portfolio file. It opens the indexed PORTFILE for input, then sequentially reads each record (dynamic access, READ NEXT), counting them and printing key fields (ID, account, client, status, total value) to the report. At the end it closes the file, prints the total record count, and sets the job return code. Error conditions handled: file-open failure. It is essentially a read-only reporting/demonstration utility over the portfolio file.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CALL 1000-INITIALIZE
WHILE NOT end of file DO
  CALL 2000-PROCESS
END WHILE
CALL 3000-TERMINATE
RETURN to caller (GOBACK)

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLEAR WS-WORK-AREAS (INITIALIZE)
OPEN PORTFOLIO-FILE for READ-ONLY
IF open NOT success THEN
  DISPLAY 'Error opening file' + status
  SET WS-RETURN-CODE = error (8)
  CALL 3000-TERMINATE
END IF

annotations.note: SME REVIEW: same pattern as PORTADD — on open failure it terminates (closes the file) but does not stop; control returns to the mainline which then reads a closed file.

paragraphs.name: 2000-PROCESS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
READ next record from PORTFOLIO-FILE (READ NEXT)
IF end of file THEN
  SET END-OF-FILE = true
ELSE
  INCREMENT WS-RECORD-COUNT
  CALL 2100-DISPLAY-RECORD
END IF
branches: READ NEXT ... AT END / NOT AT END

annotations.note: READ NEXT with DYNAMIC access mode = sequential walk through the indexed file in key order.

paragraphs.name: 2100-DISPLAY-RECORD
paragraphs.pseudocode:
DISPLAY 'Portfolio Record:' + WS-RECORD-COUNT
DISPLAY the record's ID, Account, Client, Status, Total Value (one line each)
DISPLAY a blank separator line

paragraphs.name: 3000-TERMINATE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLOSE PORTFOLIO-FILE
DISPLAY 'Total Records Read:' + WS-RECORD-COUNT
SET job RETURN-CODE = WS-RETURN-CODE
